The home side looked comfortable, stifling Milan's creative outlets while remaining lethal on the break. The pressure told again in the 39th minute. At halftime, Lazio appeared to be in total control, while AC Milan 's star-studded lineup, including the veteran Luka Modric , looked disjointed and vulnerable.
